spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  metric_name,
  value,
  timestamp
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name IN ('target_bytes_per_second', 'target_worker_bytes_per_second', 'read_uncompressed_bytes_per_second', 'read_compressed_bytes_per_second', 'insert_bytes_per_second')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp ASC
SELECT quantile(0.5)(value) FROM otelspam.perf WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND metric_name = 'read_compressed_bytes_per_second' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  metric_name as name,
  quantile(0.5)(value) as count,
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 SECOND) time
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name IN ('user_queries_per_second', 'failed_user_queries_per_second')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY name, time
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT
  attributes['query_name'] as query_name,
  quantile(0.5)(value) as value,
  toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 60 SECOND) as timestamp
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name = 'query_latency_micros'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY query_name, timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

SELECT
  -- toString(cityHash64(metric_meta)) as query_name,
  attributes['query_name'] as query_name,
  -- toStartOfSecond(timestamp) as timestamp,
  -- count(*) as count,
  any(toUInt64OrZero(attributes['perf.p90'])) as "target p90",
  quantile(0.90)(value) as p90,
  any(toUInt64OrZero(attributes['perf.p50'])) as "target p50",
  quantile(0.5)(value) as p50
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name = 'query_latency_micros'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY query_name
ORDER BY p50 DESC
LIMIT 25

spec.description: Shows the latency per query, with target percentiles also present in the chart. Starts with the target p90 and actual p90, then target p50 and actual p50.
spec.title: Latency By Query (target/actual p90, target/actual p50)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  attributes['query_name'] as query_name,
  count(*) as count
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name = 'query_latency_micros'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY query_name
ORDER BY query_name ASC
LIMIT 25

SELECT
  toString(toUInt64(attributes['time_range_seconds'])/60) as minutes,
  count() as query_count
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name = 'query_latency_micros'
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY minutes
ORDER BY toUInt64(minutes) ASC

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  (value - lagInFrame(value) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp)) as value,
  timestamp
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name IN ('program_cpu_sys_ns')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp ASC

WITH
  (SELECT value FROM otelspam.perf WHERE run_id = '${run_id}' AND metric_name = 'program_num_cpu' LIMIT 1) AS cpu_count
SELECT
  (value - lagInFrame(value) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp))/cpu_count as value,
  timestamp
FROM
  otelspam.perf
WHERE
  run_id = '${run_id}'
  AND metric_name IN ('program_cpu_user_ns')
  AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp ASC
